profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Microsoft with a passion for Esports and software development. I've pursued the legitimization of Esports in the collegiate scene and my experience in doing so has inspired me to become a more influential person in my community. To fulfill this ambition, I've developed software that aims to help others around me while expanding my knowledge of new technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced internal AWS service that validates Infrastructure as Code (IaC) when deploying to private regions, enabling engineers & teams within Amazon to share their submission results using React and Python with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and CloudFormation
• Leveraged AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and CloudWatch with Python to automate the collection and reporting of user metrics to leadership within AWS Commerce Platform
• Incorporated unit tests for the React-based website using Jest and Enzyme, expanding code coverage from 0% to 78%

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
•   Developed a Python extension in C++ that removed repetitive serialization overhead when processing analytics data, increasing product interoperability and reducing overall processing time by 30% on 600 million daily requests
•   Modernized service that calculates predictive analytics for mortgage-backed securities using Python and C++
•   Enhanced core networking interface to properly route raw wire formats for increased throughput

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•  Developed map application to visualize geographical layers using React/Redux
•  Revamped navigation and process flows, greatly improving user experience and ease of use
•  Increased code coverage from 16% to 55% by writing Unit Tests with Jest and Enzyme for CI/CD
•  Contributed to the development of services for map data caching and tile rendering using python, Django, and SQL

positions.title: Data Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•  Wrote python scripts to automate data conditioning, eliminating the manual process done by imagery analysts and saving over 400-man hours
•  Designed and developed a data entry GUI with data validation tools, optimizing data analysis accuracy and reducing Excel file sizes by 98%
•  Automated the ingestion and cleansing of badge & login data used by a seating application to create and edit seating charts for the building using Python
•  Organized and led Python learning meetings to increase data literacy in the workplace

projects.title: Virginiaesports.club
projects.description:
•  Commissioned by the Virginia Esports Association at Virginia Tech to create their club website
•  Developed with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with React

projects.title: Pscheduler.com
projects.description:
•  Implemented feature that integrated Virginia Tech's public distribution of Grade Averages data with course scheduling
•  Enabled users to generate schedules sorted by estimated GPA
•  Developed in JavaScript with React/Redux, Java Spring, and Hibernate

organizations.name: Virginia Tech League of Legends Team
organizations.description:
•  Expanded current and prospective sponsor bases for traveling expenses, equipment, and tournament fees
•  Generated $5000 in sponsorship revenue and over $20,000 in tournament winnings
•  Initiated project to have Virginia Tech legitimize Esports and recognize the players as athletes

organizations.name: Virginia Tech Programming Team
organizations.description: •  Develop logic and algorithm knowledge at a fast pace through weekly coding competitions
